edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the wallet for the whitelist signature check and as mint recipient.

msg.sender is used as the wallet for the raffle signature check and as mint recipient.

Tokens are minted directly to msg.sender inside maybeMintTokens.
msg.sender is passed as _wallet and compared to the recovered signer.
finalizeStartingIndex is public and callable by any msg.sender without restriction.
msg.sender supplies the ETH balance and receives the withdrawal; guarded only by onlyOwner.
onlyOwner compares owner() with _msgSender() to gate privileged functions.
ETH is transferred to the caller-controlled address msg.sender in withdraw.
mintStarWhitelist relies on isWalletAuthorisedToMint for off-chain authorization.
mintStarsWhitelist relies on isWalletAuthorisedToMint for off-chain authorization.
mintStarRaffle relies on isWalletAuthorisedToMint for off-chain authorization.
isWalletAuthorisedToMint delegates signer recovery to ECDSA.recover.
ECDSA.recover performs the raw ecrecover that underpins the mint authorization.
mintStarWhitelist mints exactly one token through maybeMintTokens.
mintStarsWhitelist mints two tokens through maybeMintTokens.
mintStarRaffle forwards the requested token count to maybeMintTokens.
mintStarPublic forwards the requested token count to maybeMintTokens.
maybeMintTokens calls _safeMint inside a loop, invoking external receiver code mid-loop.
Supply accounting uses SafeMath.add(totalSupply(), _num_tokens) to block overflow.
_safeMint calls _checkOnERC721Received which transfers control to the recipient.
_checkOnERC721Received performs an external functionCall to the receiving contract.
max_tokens_per_transaction bounds _num_tokens in maybeMintTokens.
max_token_supply bounds the resulting total supply in maybeMintTokens.
token_price is required to be paid by mintStarsWhitelist.
token_price multiplies the requested token count to compute the raffle payment.
token_price multiplies the requested token count to compute the public payment.

whitelist_sale_active gates mintStarsWhitelist.
public_raffle_sale_active gates mintStarRaffle.
general_sale_active gates mintStarPublic.
